title: Advanced recipe search and filtering
description: Shared execution root for delivering broader recipe search plus per-scene structured filters in the Recipes tab. This feature assumes the recipe-catalog data layer from `spec-fa73e084` is already merged before any child bead starts.
acceptance_criteria: All implementation beads assume parsed recipe metadata is already available from the catalog with no extra disk I/O during filtering.
Free-text search and structured filters compose exactly as specified: OR within tag selections, AND across search and filter axes.
The feature tree includes exactly one shared tester bead, one shared documentation bead, and one shared review bead, each sequenced after implementation work.
